comment: HH_260906 - Record measured post-publication integrity checks separately from local regression counts and model quality decisions.
limits: Counts describe checks at publication, not additional independent pytest test cases.
Markdown checks verify target existence, not every remote page or Markdown anchor.
The 72 predictions are fixed first-twelve validation anchors per fit, not representative live driving footage.
Runtime checkpoint payloads remain remote and were hashed there without deserialization.
Public run and campaign JSON views are labeled redacted derivatives; other artifacts retain original bytes as listed in the publication manifest.
